manifestMapping.derivedFrom: The 8 Light_Beams StaticMeshActor positions measured in the UE slice on 2 Oct 2026, matched to the manifest's 11 StaticMesh_Light_Beams_4400 instances by trying all 48 axis permutations and sign flips and keeping the one with the smallest worst-case residual.
manifestMapping.instancesTransform: instances[].transform[12..14] (and lights[].location) use the manifest basis (right-handed, +Y left): UE = (x, -y, z). Scale 1 (least-squares fit 0.99999), offset 0 (fit within 0.25 cm). Worst residual 0.68 cm over all 8 beams; the next-best axis mapping misses by 4314 cm.
manifestMapping.actorsLocation: actors[].location is already in UE axes: UE = (x, y, z), same 0.68 cm worst residual. All positions below come from actors[].location unless noted.

notes: Proposed viewpoints put the camera 250-400 cm from a landmark actor, about 60 cm above the floor for floor-level targets, aimed with -bioshockshotlook. Every one marked validated:false has never been captured: a wall may sit between camera and target. Capture each, Read the PNG, then either set validated:true or move/prune it.
